name: TriNet Group, Inc.
summary: TriNet Group, Inc. provides comprehensive human capital management services for small and medium-sized businesses in the United States. The company offers multi-state payroll processing and tax administration; employee benefits programs, including health insurance and retirement plans; workers' compensation insurance and claims management; employment and benefits law compliance; and other HR related services.
